abstract: Serum immunosuppressive acidic protein was compared to lactic dehydrogenase as a marker for testicular cancer in 54 patients with testicular cancer, 62 with benign urological diseases and 203 healthy controls. The mean value of serum immunosuppressive acidic protein in patients with testicular cancer (598 +/- 293 micrograms. per ml.) was statistically higher than that in patients with benign disease (429 +/- 163 micrograms. per ml.) and healthy controls (368 +/- 73 micrograms. per ml.). There were statistically significant differences in serum immunosuppressive acidic protein levels between controls and patients with stage 2 (p less than 0.0001) or stage 3 (p less than 0.001) testicular cancer, and between those with stage 1 and stage 2 (p less than 0.0001) or stage 3 (p less than 0.001) disease, respectively. The usefulness of immunosuppressive acidic protein as a marker for testicular cancer also was compared to that of lactic dehydrogenase. Immunosuppressive acidic protein and lactic dehydrogenase levels were elevated almost equally in patients with stage 2 or 3 disease (range 71 to 92 per cent). However, immunosuppressive acidic protein levels were elevated in only 3 of 25 patients with stage 1 cancer (12 per cent), compared to 11 of 25 (44 per cent) with elevated lactic dehydrogenase levels. Immunosuppressive acidic protein was correlated better with tumor stage. In conclusion, serum immunosuppressive acidic protein determinations may be useful in patients with testicular cancer for staging, monitoring treatment results and predicting recurrence.
abstract_ja: 精巣がん54例、良性泌尿器疾患62例、健常対照203例の血清免疫抑制酸性タンパク質を、精巣がんのマーカーとして乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)と比較した。血清免疫抑制酸性タンパク質の平均値は、精巣がん患者（598±293 μg/mL）で良性疾患患者（429±163 μg/mL）および健常対照（368±73 μg/mL）より統計学的に有意に高かった。対照と病期2（p<0.0001）または病期3（p<0.001）の精巣がん患者の間、および病期1と病期2（p<0.0001）または病期3（p<0.001）の患者の間で、血清免疫抑制酸性タンパク質値に統計学的に有意な差が認められた。精巣がんのマーカーとしての有用性もLDHと比較した。病期2または3の患者では、免疫抑制酸性タンパク質およびLDHの上昇はほぼ同程度であった（71～92%の範囲）。しかし病期1の患者25例中、免疫抑制酸性タンパク質の上昇は3例（12%）のみであったのに対し、LDHは25例中11例（44%）で上昇していた。免疫抑制酸性タンパク質は腫瘍の病期とよりよく相関した。結論として、精巣がん患者において血清免疫抑制酸性タンパク質の測定は、病期分類、治療成績のモニタリング、再発予測に有用である可能性がある。
